                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * Input data consists of 16-length flattened feature vectors
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * The task focuses on distinguishing different types of touch interactions based on temporal sensor signals
Despite the relatively small number of classes, the dataset captures meaningful temporal variations in touch behavior.
________________


4. Model Architectures
Two recurrent architectures are compared:
LSTM network
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * single LSTM layer with 10 neurons
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * followed by a flat input layer (length 16)
GRU network
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * single GRU layer
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * tested with 10 and 12 neurons
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * also uses flat input layer (length 16)
Both models are designed to be lightweight and suitable for efficient deployment.
________________


5. Training Configuration
Both architectures use a standard deep learning pipeline:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * optimizer: Adam
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * loss function: categorical cross-entropy
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * output activation: softmax
This configuration ensures stable training and probabilistic classification outputs.
________________


6. Performance Results
The models achieve strong classification performance:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * LSTM accuracy: 84.23% (best overall performance)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * GRU accuracy: 83.78%
Key observation:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * LSTM slightly outperforms GRU in this task
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * both architectures perform comparably overall
This suggests that both models are effective for touch modality recognition, with small differences depending on sequence structure.
________________


7. Efficiency vs Accuracy Trade-off
A major contribution of the study is demonstrating that:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * recurrent models can achieve high accuracy with extremely low computational cost
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * reducing FLOPs and memory does not significantly degrade performance
This makes them highly suitable for:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * wearable tactile systems
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * prosthetic feedback devices
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * real-time robotic interaction systems
________________


8. Key Insight: Temporal Dependencies Are Crucial
The results reinforce that:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * touch modality recognition depends heavily on temporal structure in sensor data
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * sequence-aware models (LSTM/GRU) outperform static classifiers in capturing dynamic patterns of interaction
This supports the broader idea that tactile perception is fundamentally a time-dependent signal processing problem.
________________


9. Key Contribution
This work demonstrates that:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * LSTM and GRU networks are effective and efficient for touch modality classification
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * significant reductions in computational cost are possible without major accuracy loss
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * LSTM slightly outperforms GRU in this dataset
Overall, the study provides strong evidence for using lightweight recurrent architectures in real-time tactile intelligence systems.
[58] Detecting and Identifying Tactile Gestures using Deep Autoencoders, Geometric Moments and Gesture Level Features 
1. Motivation: High-Level Affective Touch Recognition
The paper focuses on recognizing high-level affective touch gestures, which are important for:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * social robotics
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * human–robot interaction
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * affective computing systems
The goal is to move beyond raw tactile signals and instead classify meaningful social and emotional touch behaviors.
________________


2. Core Approach: Hybrid Feature + Deep Learning Methods
The study investigates a combination of:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * deep autoencoders
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * geometric moment features
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * Hidden Markov Models (HMMs)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * gesture-level statistical features
This hybrid approach is designed to capture both:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * low-level signal structure (pressure dynamics)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * higher-level temporal and spatial patterns in gestures
________________


3. Dataset: CoST Corpus
The system is evaluated on the CoST (Corpus of Social Touch) dataset, which contains:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * multiple annotated social touch gestures
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * pressure sensor recordings from a mannequin-based tactile surface
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * diverse inter-person interaction styles
This dataset is widely used for benchmarking social touch recognition methods.
________________


4. Feature Engineering Strategy
A key part of the method is the construction of hand-crafted and statistical features, including:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * mean pressure across sensors
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * standard deviation of pressure values
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * fundamental frequency of tactile signal variations
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * average center of the gesture (spatial centroid of contact)
These features aim to summarize both:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * spatial distribution of touch
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * temporal variation in pressure signals
________________


5. Deep Learning Component: Autoencoders
The model uses deep autoencoders to:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * learn compressed representations of tactile input data
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * reduce dimensionality of high-dimensional sensor readings
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * extract latent structure useful for classification
Autoencoders help transform raw tactile signals into more compact feature representations that can improve downstream classification performance.
________________


6. Temporal Modeling: Hidden Markov Models (HMMs)
HMMs are used to model:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * sequential structure of tactile gestures
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * transitions between different contact states over time
This is particularly important because touch gestures are inherently temporal sequences rather than static patterns.
________________


7. Classification Performance
The combined model achieves a classification accuracy of:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * 47.17% on the CoST dataset
This performance is relatively low compared to more modern deep learning approaches (e.g., CNN-based or RNN-based models), indicating limitations in feature representation or model capacity.
________________


8. Key Limitation: Lower Accuracy vs Deep Learning Methods
The relatively modest performance suggests:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * handcrafted + hybrid features may not fully capture complex spatiotemporal structure
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * autoencoders + HMM combinations may struggle with high variability in human touch behavior
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * more recent end-to-end deep learning models outperform this hybrid pipeline
________________


9. Key Insight: Importance of Multi-Level Feature Design
Despite lower accuracy, the paper highlights an important idea:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * effective tactile recognition benefits from combining:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * statistical features (pressure, duration, center)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * learned latent features (autoencoders)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * temporal models (HMMs)
This reflects an early attempt to integrate feature engineering with representation learning for tactile intelligence.
________________


10. Key Contribution
The main contribution of this work is:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * introducing a hybrid recognition framework combining autoencoders, geometric moments, and HMMs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * demonstrating that gesture-level and statistical tactile features can support classification
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * providing a baseline for social touch recognition using structured feature pipelines
Overall, it represents an early step toward data-driven affective touch recognition systems, but highlights the need for more powerful deep learning architectures.
[59] Detecting and Classifying Human Touches in a Social Robot Through Acoustic Sensing and Machine Learning 
1. Motivation: Acoustic Tactile Sensing in Robotics
This work explores the use of acoustic signals (sound vibrations) as an alternative modality for tactile sensing in social robots.
Instead of relying on dense arrays of physical tactile sensors, the system uses contact microphones embedded in the robot’s structure to capture vibrations generated by human touch interactions.
Key motivation:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * reduce sensor hardware complexity
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * increase coverage with fewer sensing elements
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * enable robust touch detection in noisy environments
Recent studies show that acoustic sensing is particularly promising because vibrations propagate efficiently through solid materials, making it suitable for whole-body robotic sensing systems.
________________


2. Core Idea: Touch Recognition via Sound Signatures
The central idea is that each touch interaction produces a unique acoustic signature in the robot’s structure.
These signatures can be used to:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * detect whether a touch occurred
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * classify the type of touch gesture
Common gestures include:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * stroke
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * tap
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 * slap
