                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * analysis of how user variability impacts performance
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * evidence that skin-like sensors significantly outperform simpler force-only sensors
Overall, it demonstrates that bio-inspired tactile sensing improves robustness and accuracy in social touch recognition systems, but also highlights the persistent challenge of generalization across users.


[64] Touch Modality Interpretation for an EIT-Based Sensitive Skin 
1. Motivation: EIT-Based Sensitive Skin for Social Robotics
This work explores Electrical Impedance Tomography (EIT)-based artificial skin for enabling robots to interpret human touch.
EIT-based skins are attractive because they:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * provide large-area coverage with minimal wiring (edge electrodes only)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * are flexible and stretchable
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * can be embedded into robotic bodies for full-body tactile sensing
The goal is to enable robots to understand different touch modalities, improving social interaction and responsiveness in human–robot systems.
________________


2. Core Challenge: Ill-Posed Inverse Problem in EIT
A fundamental issue in EIT systems is that reconstruction is an ill-conditioned inverse problem:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * only boundary voltage measurements are available
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * internal conductivity distribution must be inferred indirectly
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * many Jacobian elements are close to zero
This leads to:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * high numerical sensitivity
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * amplification of noise in measurements
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * unstable reconstructions
To address this, the system requires regularisation techniques to stabilize the inverse solution.
________________


3. Sensing Mechanism and Data Acquisition
The system uses a controlled electrical stimulation setup:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * constant DC current: 1.8 mA
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * injected through adjacent boundary electrodes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * voltage measured from all other electrodes relative to a reference electrode
Key characteristics:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * 224 independent voltage measurements per time step
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * data acquisition and reconstruction speed up to 60 Hz
This enables near real-time tactile sensing and interpretation.
________________


4. Feature Extraction for Touch Modality Classification
The model uses a feature-based representation of tactile signals, including:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * intensity change
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * point localisation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * two-point discrimination threshold
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * contact area
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * temporal information
These features capture both:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * spatial distribution of touch
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * temporal evolution of interaction
This enables classification of different touch modalities (e.g., pat, stroke, press, slap).
________________


5. Machine Learning Approach: Boosting Classifier
A key contribution of the work is the use of a boosting-based classifier (LogitBoost) for touch modality recognition.
This is notable because:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * earlier EIT systems primarily used simpler classification methods
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * boosting improves decision boundary learning from noisy tactile data
The study represents one of the first applications of:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * boosting methods for EIT-based touch interpretation
________________


6. Performance and Results
Experimental results show:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * classification accuracy around ~74–80% depending on setup
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * performance decreases when evaluated across more participants due to variability
Key observation:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * increasing subject diversity significantly reduces accuracy
This highlights a major limitation in tactile learning systems:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * inter-person variability strongly affects generalization performance
________________


7. Key Limitation: User Variability
The study finds that:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * touch patterns vary significantly between individuals
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * even the same gesture can produce different force distributions
This leads to:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * reduced classification performance in multi-user scenarios
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * challenges in building fully generalizable models
This is a recurring issue across tactile datasets and systems.
________________


8. Key Insight: Need for Multimodal Integration
A key conclusion is that touch interpretation should not be treated in isolation.
Instead, it should be integrated with:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * vision (who is touching and context)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * audio (interaction cues, speech)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * behavioural context
This multimodal fusion is important because:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * touch alone may be ambiguous
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * social meaning often depends on environmental context
________________


9. Key Contribution
This work contributes:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * one of the first EIT-based systems for touch modality interpretation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * a full sensing pipeline including stimulation, reconstruction, and classification
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * feature-based representation of tactile signals
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * demonstration that boosting classifiers can effectively classify social touch
Overall, it establishes EIT-based skins as a viable platform for large-area, socially-aware robotic touch perception, while highlighting challenges in noise sensitivity and user generalization.


[65] Deep Learning Fundamentals (Yann LeCun) 
1. Motivation: Deep Learning as a Representation Learning Framework
Deep learning is a subfield of machine learning focused on learning hierarchical representations of data using multi-layer neural networks.
The central idea is that complex tasks (e.g., vision, speech, language understanding) require:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * multiple levels of abstraction
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * learned feature hierarchies rather than handcrafted features
This aligns with LeCun’s view that intelligence systems must learn representations directly from raw data through experience.
________________


2. Core Concept: Deep Architectures and Representation Learning
According to LeCun, deep learning is based on:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * stacked non-linear transformations
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * hierarchical feature learning
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * end-to-end optimization using gradient-based methods
Key insight:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * shallow models are often insufficient for complex perceptual tasks
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * deep architectures are required to capture invariances and structured patterns in data
Deep learning is therefore fundamentally a form of representation learning, where each layer transforms the data into progressively more abstract representations.
________________


3. Learning Mechanism: Backpropagation and Optimization
Deep neural networks are trained using:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * backpropagation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * gradient-based optimization methods (e.g., stochastic gradient descent)
This allows:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * adjustment of internal parameters across multiple layers
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * learning from large-scale datasets without manual feature design
LeCun emphasizes that deep learning relies on optimizing highly non-convex functions in high-dimensional parameter spaces.
________________


4. Key Architectural Insight: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs)
A major contribution associated with LeCun is the development of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs).
Key properties:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * local receptive fields
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * weight sharing
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * translation invariance
CNNs drastically reduce parameter complexity while preserving spatial structure, making them highly effective for image and signal processing tasks.
________________


5. Key Challenges in Deep Learning (LeCun Perspective)
LeCun identifies two major challenges in machine learning systems:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * Deep Learning Problem
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * difficulty of training deep, highly non-linear models
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * complex optimization landscape
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * Normalization / Stability Problem
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * ensuring stable representations across layers
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * avoiding exploding/vanishing gradients
These challenges highlight why architectural innovations and training techniques are critical.
________________


6. Key Idea: Learning from Data at Scale
A core principle of LeCun’s work is that:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * intelligence emerges from learning large-scale predictive models
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * systems improve with more data, parameters, and computational power
Modern deep learning systems:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    * scale with data
